name: fiu-mcp-server
description: Provided by FIU, a financial information provider. Search global market quotes, news and financial data, covering A-shares(Zhcall), Hong Kong stocks, US stocks and Japanese stocks, plus global indices, funds and bond markets. Supports quote and order-book data, candlestick and intraday charts, industry sectors, financial statements, announcements, corporate actions, share capital and shareholder data, ETF NAV and holdings, IPOs, bonds, options, financial news, investment and economic calendars, macroeconomic data, and securities/fund ticker search. The service provides objective data and financial data retrieval only; it does not constitute investment analysis or buy/sell recommendations.

display.name: 融聚汇 FIU全球金融数据
